name: Land Use Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the City Council's
  LAND USE COMMITTEE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JULY 19, 2023 – 3:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:

This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. The Public may join this meeting virtually or
attend in-person at City Hall.

Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
11:00 a.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to Land Use Committee
Members prior to the meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-
Supplemental-Packets.

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:.
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84272630947
  842 7263 0947
  Webinar ID:
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16699009128,,84272630947# OR +16694449171,,84272630947#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 or +1 669 444 9171 or +1 253 215 8782 or +1 346 248 7799

Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Committee Chair.
The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to speak must “raise their hand”, at
which time they will be unmuted.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the Committee Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are
available for public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during
normal business hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
Committee-Supplemental-Packets
 CALL TO ORDER  3:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Pro Tem Davis and Councilmember Honig

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Land Use Committee on items not on the printed agenda. Please
observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or
otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page 1 of this agenda.
When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it City Staff prior to the meeting starting.

BUSINESS:

1.  Conditional Use Permit No. 98-001, Modification No. 2
  Applicant: Alexia Liavas
  Project Address: 5700 Corsa Avenue, Suite 106
  Project Description: Request for a time extension to authorize the continued operation and
  an expansion of a dance studio.

2.  Conditional Use Permit No. 18-003, Modification No. 2
  Applicant: Anthony Virella
  Project Address: 31230 Cedar Valley Drive
  Project Description: Request for a time extension to authorize the continued operation of
  an instructional fitness facility.

3.  Conditional Use Permit 23-004
  Applicant: Jennifer Kang
  Project Address: 5790 Lindero Canyon Road, Suite 2A
  Project Description: Request for a conditional use permit to renew a previously expired
  conditional use permit to authorize the sale of alcohol for onsite consumption in
  conjunction with the operation of an existing restaurant.

4.  Conditional Use Permit No. 23-005
  Applicant: Liliya Bezinover
  Project Address: 31149 Via Colinas, Suites 601 & 602
  Project Description: Request for a new conditional use permit to authorize the sale of
  alcohol for onsite and offsite consumption in conjunction with the operation of a new
  restaurant.

5.  Conditional Use Permit No. 23-003
  Applicant: Massimo Forti
  Project Address: 30770 Russell Ranch Road, Suite G
  Project Description: Request to reinstate a conditional use permit that was revoked by the
  City Council on February 24, 2021 that authorized the sale of alcohol for onsite and offsite
  consumption in conjunction with the operation of a restaurant.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, July 13, 2023 at 5:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.
